title: Ocean Letter Splash
hook: Ocean Letter Splash—from shore to sea!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet after the letter cue
visualStyle: friendly polished 3D storybook ocean art, aqua and coral palette, soft rounded shapes, clean preschool character design

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: child-sized observer following one widening ripple from reef to shore, depth, surface, and current
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: title hook that resets the water-motion identity and anchors the first song of the catalog
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: rolling 4/4 acoustic-pop with a light triplet undertow
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written ocean-and-coast snapshots; natural rhyme and assonance travel across neighboring targets, then release into plain vivid fact when accuracy needs room
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: letter cue -> one real beat -> target -> one semantic action; retrieval clues rotate among motion, shape, habitat, and function instead of repeating one instruction
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 begins spare and widens by layer; choruses open the harmony; the interlude nearly empties; Round 2 is stop-start voice-first recall; the final chorus is fullest before the tide-like outro strips back
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: two-note marimba ripple answers after target words, never on their first syllable
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the first song of the catalog feel like one widening ripple: it touches reef, coast, sheltered water, seafloor, surface breath, and open current, then returns home. The alphabet should feel carried by changing water, not stacked as twenty-six facts.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: One ripple is the recurring image. Water verbs widen, bob, fan, slip, drift, rise, breathe, and return; each four-letter chunk changes the water layer or scale, while object-specific facts keep the imagery honest.
semanticArc: one ripple opens across reef and surface
water crosses reef shelter toward coast and seafloor
the view deepens then repeatedly rises toward air and light
open current carries the last letters back to the first ripple
